gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-hind-vadodara: Refined and a touch luxurious, Stentiga spreads its letters wide. Hind Vadodara sits beneath it in sturdy, rounded sans-serif forms, with big open bowls that feel friendly and tidy next to such a dressed-up heading.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-khula: Stentiga draws every line at a single width. Its spaced-out capitals look ornate and showy, while Khula, a modern sans-serif with a tall midsection and open curves, simply gets on with being easy to read.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-krub: Luxurious and spread out, Stentiga keeps its round bowls perfectly uniform in thickness. Krub follows with a contemporary sans-serif body, its pronounced x-height and unfinished curves giving the pair a relaxed, unfussy confidence.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-kufam: Stentiga opens wide with refined, generously tracked capitals that look expensive. Kufam, a sans-serif with tube-like strokes and open curves in its e, keeps its bodies large and lets the ascenders stay modest.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-liter: Liter reads as a plain sans with no stroke contrast at all and lowercase that stands tall on the line. And Stentiga, with its wide tracking and doorway-open letters, gives that sturdiness a refined, luxurious head.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-mada: Wide-set, doorway-open letters with crossbars as heavy as the stems give Stentiga its look. Mada, a plain sans with curves that refuse to close and a towering midzone, makes the strongest quality here a friendly, modern ease.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-martel-sans: Stentiga spreads its letters wide and draws its curves and straights with the same line width, which feels refined. Martel Sans, a plain sans, is the one with generous openings and a high mean line.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Stentiga spreads out in luxurious, ruler-drawn lines, every stroke held to a constant width and every letter given room. Noto Sans Adlam keeps its curve endings well apart, so longer text would stay clear and unhurried.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-noto-sans-adlam-u: Refined and a little grand, Stentiga holds a quiet, level beat. Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined, a plain sans with generous space at its curve ends, lets that spaced-out heading breathe, with little height difference between its cases.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-noto-sans-balines: Spaced-out and statuesque, Stentiga looks drawn with a compass pencil. And Noto Sans Balinese, a plain sans with breathing space inside every curve and short ascenders, makes the strongest quality here a modern, professional steadiness.
